_comment: REGRESSION FIXTURE for analyze_never.py's C2 probe.
This is the ground truth produced by an ad-hoc probe that rebuilt all 37
`never`+`manifest=corrupts` mutants at `-rtc=all --disable-assert-hoist`
(every guard forced on, assertion hoisting disabled) and executed them.
It was NOT produced by analyze_never.py's own probe_execute() -- it was a
one-off heredoc in a terminal, so without this file the result would exist
only in scrollback and could not be re-checked.
USE: run `analyze_never.py --execute` and diff its per-mutant verdict against
this table. probe_execute() classifies into six statuses; the mapping to the
verdict vocabulary used here is
choreo-guard-fired / entry-check-fired / shape-check-fired -> GUARD
oracle-only                            -> oracle
runtime-lib-bounds                     -> runtime-lib-bounds
crash-only                             -> crash
passed-no-detection                    -> pass
CORRECTION 2026-09-09 (labels only -- no raw evidence changed). Two rows,
M2.s4.ln1.caller.out and M2.s4.ln3.caller.out, were originally recorded as
`oracle`. Both logs read `choreo assertion failed: Index out of bounds` with
NO source-location suffix. That is source B -- the bounds check inside
choreo's own ArrayProxy::operator[] (runtime/choreo.h:394/405/782/791/884) --
not source C, the kernel's built-in numeric reference check (the specs Sec.7
oracle). The original ad-hoc probe folded B into C because both print the
`choreo assertion failed:` prefix; the location suffix is what separates them,
since only the generated ASSESSMENTS (sources A-host and A-device) append
`, <path>:<line>.<col>`.
This matters and is not cosmetic. Source B is NOT independent ground truth:
the Sec.7 oracle reads its own operands through ArrayProxy, so a mutated index
can trip B from INSIDE the oracle arm. Verified sites include
layer_normalization/1_bert_32x512x768_768_768.co:90 (`out[i][j][k]`),
3_attention_32xNx512x64_64_64.co:93 (`out[i][j][k][l]`) and
softmax/common.hpp:70 (`output_##func[h][w][c]`). Crediting those two
detections to the oracle would overstate how much independent numerical
verification the suite has. Both rows are cause=C4_NOT_ASSESSED, so the cause
model is unaffected -- choreo's assessor produced nothing either way.
The correction is a vocabulary change, not a re-measurement: verdict_totals
moves oracle 15 -> 13 and adds runtime-lib-bounds 2. Raw probe output is now
banked at raw/probe_raw/<mutant_id>.<hoist_on|hoist_off>.txt (62 files = 31
probed mutants x 2 arms; the 6 C5 rows return before probing), so unlike the
original one-off heredoc this table can now be re-checked against evidence
rather than against scrollback.
WHY IT MATTERS. It establishes that S2 is CONFIGURATION-DEPENDENT: 35/72 at
the pinned default -rtc level, 43/72 with emission policy and hoisting both
forced. The 8 recoverable detections are exactly the 8 GUARD rows, all
layer_normalization. It also independently validates the ledger-only
classifier: every cause below agrees with its row (0 disagreements over 37).
PROVENANCE: measured on the `680533f` binary (build-release/choreo, built
2026-09-08T23:24:18). The checkout has since moved to f2f238f. A rebuild
invalidates this table and it must be re-measured before either result is
reported as a live croqtile bug.

verdict_meaning.GUARD: choreo's OWN bound guard fired -- the bug IS detectable by choreo; E1 recorded `never` only because of emission policy and/or guard placement
verdict_meaning.oracle: only the kernel's built-in numeric reference check (specs §7 oracle) fired -- no choreo guard could catch this
verdict_meaning.runtime-lib-bounds: choreo's ArrayProxy bounds check fired (`Index out of bounds`, no location suffix). NOT the assessor and NOT independent ground truth -- the §7 oracle reads its own operands through ArrayProxy, so this can fire from inside the oracle arm
verdict_meaning.crash: aborted rc=134 with NO attribution message on stdout -- a device-side trap, not a detection
verdict_meaning.pass: nothing fired at all; the mutant ran to completion -- consistent with matmul having no usable oracle and no element-access obligations

_comment: Cross-check of the LEDGER-ONLY classifier against this probe, run after the
three classifier fixes (paren-normalized index matching, `.span(N)` surface
pattern, relevance-gated C1). 0 disagreements over 37 mutants.
WHICH CLASSIFIER. This block describes analyze_never.py WITHOUT --execute,
i.e. raw/never_attribution_ledgeronly.json, whose cause_totals are
{C1: 8, C3: 4, C4: 19, C5: 6, HOISTING_DEFECT: 0}. The --execute run promotes
6 of those 8 C1 rows to HOISTING_DEFECT once the probe shows the guard fires
only with --disable-assert-hoist, giving {HOISTING_DEFECT: 6, C1: 2, C3: 4,
C4: 19, C5: 6} in raw/never_attribution.json. Both are correct for their own
inputs; do not read HOISTING_DEFECT: 0 below as a claim about the execute run.
EXPECT is what each cause PREDICTS the probe must say. C1/C2 predict GUARD
because they claim choreo had the right verdict and lost it downstream, so
forcing everything on must recover it. C3 predicts oracle/crash because a
missing bound obligation cannot be recovered by any flag. C4 predicts
oracle/crash/pass/runtime-lib-bounds because nothing was assessed, so whatever
fires comes from outside the assessor. C5 predicts oracle because a value
error is only catchable numerically.
classifier_agreement.observed_note: C4_NOT_ASSESSED/oracle was 5 before the source-B correction; 2 of those rows are now runtime-lib-bounds. Totals are unchanged at 37.

_comment: The 8 are NOT one phenomenon. Comparing the two probe arms separates them,
and the paper must not report all 8 as 'emission policy'. Doing so would
understate a fixable codegen bug by 6 detections.
recovered_split.emission_policy_def: guard fires in BOTH arms -- recovered by -rtc=all alone; the assessment was simply never emitted at the default check level
recovered_split.hoisting_defect_def: guard fires ONLY with --disable-assert-hoist -- emitted but placed where it cannot fire; a genuine codegen hoisting bug. These 6 are exactly the rows analyze_never.py --execute promotes to cause=HOISTING_DEFECT.

s2_implication.note: All 8 are layer_normalization (7 M1 + M2.s4.ln1.out). The paper must say which configuration its S2 number describes; the abstract's 210/210 is a different mutant population AND a different emission/hoisting configuration. Attribute 6 of the 8 lost detections to a fixable codegen hoisting bug and only 2 to the cost/emission policy -- do not collapse all 8 into 'policy'.
